item.title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Part 1 Closes Historic 266-Day Theatrical Run
item.description: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle - Akaza Sairai officially closed its primary Japanese box office run on April 9, 2026.

item.title: Nintendo Launches Free 'Hello, Yoshi!' App for Kids: Everything Parents Need to Know
item.description: Nintendo officially released the free Hello, Yoshi! app on April 9 across the Nintendo Switch, iOS, and Android platforms.

item.title: Toei Launches "Kamen Rider Animated" Label With Aniplex and Shirogumi
item.description: Toei has officially established “The Kamen Rider Animated,” a new production label dedicated entirely to anime feature films based on the iconic tokusatsu franchise.

item.title: Love Live! Hasunosora TV Anime Announced for January 2027 Alongside Upcoming May Movie
item.description: Love Live! Hasunosora Girls’ High School Idol Club is officially getting a TV anime adaptation premiering in January 2027.

item.title: Be Forever Yamato: Rebel 3199 Film 6 Teases Massive Plot Twist: Modern Tokyo Appearance & June Release Date
item.description: The highly anticipated sixth film in the Space Battleship Yamato remake series, Aoi Meikyū (Blue Labyrinth), will officially hit Japanese theaters on June 26, 2026.
